agent: The owner, working through their AI agent Me Fighter (RULES.md §12); the call-8 changes were written by Me Fighter.
style: The owner as a pressure fighter: the owner's photo-built head on a muscular MakeHuman body in a charcoal rash guard, shorts and white hand wraps.
claims: The head is a KeenTools FaceBuilder (trial) head fitted to three of the owner's photos, with its texture projected from those photos (source/build_photo_head_facebuilder.py).

The body was rebuilt from scratch with MPFB2 2.0.18 and the CC0 MakeHuman system assets, using the same body macros as Grok's published recipe (source/01_build_body.py); no file from Grok's folder is used.
The body skin is MakeHuman's CC0 'middleage caucasian male' albedo, tinted per channel to the median cheek colour of the owner's FaceBuilder texture (source/03_assemble.py).
The lower neck of the FaceBuilder texture (which had the owner's shirt collar baked in) is faded to the tinted body neck colour, and the lower neck geometry is conformed radially onto the body neck.

The rash guard, shorts and hand wraps are offset and solidified copies of body faces that share the body skin weights; folds are procedural displacement, not cloth simulation. source/cloth.py (Blender 4.2.3) later smoothed and slightly inflated the garments, smoothed their hem loops, added a ribbed hem-trim material band and a separate darker shorts material, and tightened the fabric texture scale. The Blender re-export in cloth.py accidentally compressed the 28 original clips to 0.8x length (24 vs 30 fps); source/retime.py rescales their keyframe times by 1.25 so every clip matches its original duration. In v3.4, source/04_garments_v34.py (Blender 4.2.3) rebuilt the rash guard and shorts from the previous garments: it keeps the outer surface, voxel-remeshes it and smooths it with Laplacian smoothing, which removes the old wavy stripe displacement. It also fills the armpit gaps, smooths the neck, sleeve and leg hem loops into clean edge loops with a ribbed trim and a turned-under edge, and adds procedural sine crease folds and waistband gathers. The shirt is extended down under the shorts waistband to close the waist gap. Weights are transferred from the old garments; there is still no cloth simulation.
The hair is painted into the head texture; there are no hair cards, shells or strands.

The rig is MPFB's mixamo rig; the 28 original shared clips are retargeted onto it by source/02_retarget.py; the 2 newer clips (throw, thrown) were added later by source/addclips.py, the same retarget math run on the imported fighter.glb rig in Blender 4.2.3, so all 30 clips are present, then source/fix_feet.py re-solves per-frame foot pitch to match the Mixamo source relative to rest and adjusts hip height to the source's foot clearance (scaled by hip-height ratio). Neither cloth nor body physics are simulated. The arena's optional knockdown_front, getup_back and getup_front clips (assets/mixamo/extra) were added by source/05_add_extra_clips.py with the same retarget math at 30 fps and foot-fixed by fix_feet.py. source/06_retime.py restores the other 30 clips to their original durations after the Blender round-trip, and the validator's clip-length check passes.
The validator reports 46.6 MB, 213,571 triangles, 30/30 animations and 10 embedded textures, with the largest texture 2050 px.

The four renders in renders/ (front, three_quarter, profile, closeup) were regenerated in call 8 by tools/render.mjs (three.js r160 in headless Chrome, pose fighting_idle at t = 0.4 s) and are not retouched.

Call 8 (v3.7), written by the owner's AI agent Me Fighter: source/07_fit_v37.py (Blender 5.2.3) merges the rash guard's UV-seam split vertices, pulls fabric that is more than 11 mm (13 mm at hems) off the body back in, Taubin-smooths it (hem loops follow their neighbours), and blends body skin weights onto the rash guard only where the body surface is within 3 cm with agreeing normals, followed by Laplacian weight smoothing. It also blends the head's lower-neck vertex weights toward the body's weights over a 4.6 cm ramp. The shorts, hand wraps, body, face, hair, materials and all animation clips are unchanged.
